 Emanuel Navarrete vs O’Shaquie Foster: Live blog, round-by-round and results
 Emanuel Navarrete and O’Shaquie Foster fight for three belts at super featherweight!
 by Scott Christ and Wil Esco Updated Oct 25, 2026, 3:52 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Top Rank Emanuel Navarrete and O’Shaquie Foster are set to square off in a big title unification at 130 lbs tonight, with three belts on the line, as well as the clear claim to the No. 1 spot in the super featherweight division.
 Navarrete will be putting his IBF and WBO titles on the line against Foster’s WBC belt in what is definitely the most highly-anticipated fight at 130 lbs this year.
 Wil Esco will lead the call for us this evening, with updates and results for the three undercard bouts, then live, round-by-round updates for the main event. Join us tonight!
 Navarrete vs Foster live blog and results
 O’Shaquie Foster def. Emanuel Navarrete by Unanimous Decision, unifying IBF, WBO and WBC super featherweight titles
 Instant Reaction : Masterclass performance from Foster, who was in control of the fight early and often. Foster’s sharp boxing, movement, and preparedness to counter lunging punches paved the way towards a wide points lead, nearly even closing the show in the final round when he twice dropped Navarrete. It was Foster’s best performance against his perhaps his best opponent to date. Foster is quickly making a name for himself. 
 Official Scores: 115-111, 118-108, 118-108 for Foster Unanimous Decision. 
 Round 12: Foster comes out attacking immediately. Navarrete lands two body shots. BOTH FIGHTERS EXCHANGE AND NAVARRETE GOES DOWN! Foster looking to hook and uppercut and smother and stay on top of Navarrete in the hopes of forcing a stoppage. Navarrete gets his wits about him and Foster gets back to boxing. COUNTER RIGHT DROPS NAVARRETE AGAIN! Navarrete gets up and knows he has about 30 seconds to score a knockout of Foster. Huge round for Foster, obviously. Foster 10-7, 118-108 on my card. 
 Round 11: Foster’s corner want him to step on the gas right from the start of this round. Right hand lands to the body for Foster. Left uppercut from Foster lands clean. Navarrete goes to the body. Left hook lands up close for Foster, then a right hand up top. Right hand lands down to the body hard for Navarrete. Navarrete lands an uppercut and he chases Foster around the ring. Navarrete 10-9, 101-108. 
 Round 10: Body shot lands for Foster to start this round. Navarrete comes out throwing even more punches and gets Foster pinned to the ropes. Navarrete continues to throw, Foster tries to counter before deciding to tie up. Foster lands clean counters at close range. Foster standing his ground with Navarrete and landing the better punches. Navarrete gets backed into the corner and clipped. Uppercut lands for Navarrete, Foster gets one back. Foster making Navrrete pay for every punch thrown or landed. Foster 10-9, 99-91. 
 Round 9: Body shot lands for Foster. Foster comes forward behind three shots and then tries to follow it up to back Navarrete to the corner. Three punches land for Foster at center ring. Foster countering nearly every time Navarrete throws right now.Foster digs the body with a right hand and then counters to the head and body. Clean right hand from Foster picks off Navarrete. Right hand lead scores for Foster, who is running away with the fight. Foster 10-9, 89-82. 
 Round 8: Counters from Foster land clean to start the round. Foster lands a right hand with Navarrete along the ropes. Foster applying pressure and looking to break Navarrete down. Uppercut lands for Foster on the inside. Nice body shot gets in for Foster. Navarrete lands a right hand downstairs. Navarrete scores a straight right now. Navarrete scores a jab coming forward. Foster sharp on defense, ducking a series of hooks. Could go either way, I’m still leaning Foster, 79-73. 
 Round 7: Navarrete starts with a hook to the body. Uppercut lands for Foster, who stunds Navarrete! Right hook lands to the body for Foster as Navarrete goes into a shell. Right hand from Navarrete lands over the top. Foster lands two counters at close range. Navarrete lands a couple of punches as he gets Foster pinned to the ropes for a moment. Right hand lead lands for Foster. Foster is picking Navarrete off more often than not. Foster 10-9, 69-64. 
 Round 6: Foster circles the ring and catches Navarrete with a counter right. Now Foster lands a couple of clean counters at center ring. Left lands to the body for Navarrete. Navarrete goes down on a slip. Long jab lands for Navarrete. Foster lands his own jab at center ring. Clean uppercut lands for Foster as Navarrete walks in. Mild skirmish as the round ends. Foster 10-9, 59-55. 
 Round 5: Right hand lands over the top for Foster, who follows it up with a left hook. Navarrete gets in a shot as Foster looks to retreat from an attack. Double left hook comes from Foster, who evades a couple of punches from Navarrete in return. Foster 10-9, 49-46. 
 Round 4: Foster comes forward and stabs the body with several jabs. Check hook lands clean for Foster. Foster backing Navarrete up to the ropes and trying to turn the tide on Navarrete. Counter right lands clean for Foster. Navarrete misses on a huge left hook as Foster gets underneath. Foster throws two quick straight shots to beat Navarrete to the punch. Foster 10-9, 39-37. 
 Round 3: Navarrete gets in a body shot once Foster accidentially corners himself. Left hook from Navarrete lands now. Long attack comes from Navarrete who throws a dozen punches that has Foster on the defensive along the ropes. Long jab lands from Navarrete, then another. Good bounce back round for Navarrete, who gets a grin out of Foster for the punches landed on him. Navarrete 10-9, 28-29. 
 Round 2: Foster comes out and strikes with straight shots and then gets on the moves, then counters, and moves again. Navarrete having real trouble keeping up with the speed combined with the tactics of Foster. Straight right lands to the body for Foster. Navarrete lands a glancing shot that throws Foster off balance but he at least has a moment to impose some physicality. Foster smothering Navarrete who is trying to get some mauling action done now. Foster 10-9, 20-18. 
 Round 1: Fighters touch gloves to start the round, a sign of mutual respect. Foster leaps in with a lead left hook and clips a surprised Navarrete. Lunging attack from Navarrete misses and Foster steps off the line. Another leaping hook comes from Foster, who seems to be taking a page out of Floyd Mayweather vs Diego Corrales. Counter right hand lands from Foster before tying up Navarrete. Foster boxed a clean, clean round. Foster 10-9. 
 Albert Gonzalez def. Edward Vazquez by KO in Round 2
 Gonzalez’s early patience in the face of a fierce attack from Vazquez paid off quickly, as ironic as that sounds when talking about a second round stoppage. Once Gonzalez found a couple of punches that shook Vazquez up, it was all over and what was expected to be a war turned out to be an early pasting. 
 It’s over. Gonzalez KO-2 (1:04). 
 Gonzalez lands a hard counter and has Vazquez reeling in the second. Vazquez taking a lot of punishment from ropes to rope until he finally goes down! Vazquez can’t beat the count. 
 Vazquez comes out fast, throwing both hands and trying to apply a lot of pressure on Gonzalez. Gonzalez keeping his hands at home while taking the measure of Vazquez. 
 Frank Martin def. Tarik Zaina by TKO in Round 7
 Frank Martin was struggling a bit in this appearance, never really getting out of second gear until he found a clean counter left in the seventh that set up the eventual stoppage. Martin, himself, would admit he didn’t performance as he would’ve hoped, but was still content to have scored a stoppage win. 
 THE REFEREE HAS TO INTERVENE WITH MARTIN ON THE ATTACK! MARTIN TKO-7 (2:38). 
 MARTIN DROPS ZAINA HARD IN THE 7TH! 
 Zaina having intermittent success with his long range punching. I have Martin with a one round lead after five. 
 Zaina has a good third round, landing a couple of really good power shots. 
 Martin seemingly has the early edge but not by much. He seems a little tentative and Zaina is fighting a cagey fight. The crowd isn’t particularly pleased through two rounds. 
 D eric “Scooter” Davis def. Joaquin Faccio by Unanimous Decision
 Official Scores: 80-72, 80-72, 80-72 for Deric “Scooter” Davis. 
 Faccio withstood a tremendous amount of punishment to the body to make it to the final bell. We’re going to the cards but I’ve basically got it a shutout for Scooter. 
 Vicious body attack comes from Scooter in the 6th, Faccio trying to match but can’t quite match the craft. 
 Scooter scoring clean and clear, and more consistently. I’ve got him up 4-0, halfway through the fight. 
 Man, this Faccio character has some awkward footwork that I suppose is meant to be flashy, but it doesn’t seem to actually serve any tactical purpose unless it’s like some weird psychological warfare. 
 Faccio the aggressor but Scooter picking him off with sharp and straight punches, showcasing some good defensive maneuvering in the opening round. 
 How to watch Navarrete vs Foster
 Start time: 8 pm ET
 Streaming: DAZN (subscription)
 Location: Frost Bank Center - San Antonio, TX, USA
 Navarrete vs Foster main card lineup
 Emanuel Navarrete vs O’Shaquie Foster , super featherweights, 12 rounds, unification for Navarrete’s IBF and WBO titles and Foster’s WBC title 
 Albert Gonzalez vs Edward Vazquez , featherweights, 10 rounds 
 Frank Martin vs Tarik Zaina , super lightweights, 10 rounds 
 Deric “Scooter” Davis vs Joaquin Faccio , lightweights, 8 rounds 
 Note: Steven Navarro was originally slated to face Emanuel Moreno on the main card, but the fight was canceled after Navarro missed weight.
